title: Exploitation All the Way Down: Calling out the Root Cause of Bad Online Experiences for Users of the “Majority World.”

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of the severe disparities in NLP resources, automated moderation failure rates, and generative AI availability (e.g., ChatGPT) between English/European languages and low-resource languages spoken by the Global Majority.

Examining case studies of content moderation failures caused by enforcing Western-centric 'one-size-fits-all' policies that ignore the local customs, traditions, and diverse realities of Global Majority populations.

Analyzing the disproportionate allocation of Big Tech's content moderation resources, budgets, and algorithmic protections toward Western countries (e.g., the US and Europe), while actively exploiting the labor of content moderators from the Global South.
